initial_failure.cause: Four ambiguous assert_eq diagnostics plus a move from a match-guard binding in new service boundary tests. Explicit macro import and borrowing corrected the fixture.
initial_failure.source_change_during_failed_compile: Only Cargo.lock changed as the new component dependency was resolved; code fingerprint scope stayed unchanged.

separate_host_gate.source_note: Only Cargo.lock changed during this gate from new API dependency resolution. All recorded code files stayed unchanged; the whole scoped manifest correctly reports false.
separate_host_gate.ignored_note: The parent-death subprocess helper is ignored as a top-level case and explicitly launched by its passing parent regression.

post_test_notes: Scoped fix made two mechanical changes in service_operations.rs/process_session.rs and reported two process_open warnings.
A documented await_holding_invalid_type expectation preserves the intentional admission mutex: it orders epoch allocation and bounded transport admission, never replies or cleanup.

The process_open identity expect was changed to typed malformed-reply handling. This is defensive behavior after the passing test run; the new missing-identity branch was not separately exercised in that run.
Final fix compiled with exit 0, unchanged source and no warnings in its log.
Global integration formatting changed the recorded process/host files and unrelated high-level shutdown files; final hashes match the immutable WIP. No new exact-tree runtime run is implied.
implemented: Versioned file_search contract/value codecs preserve exact roots, same-platform non-UTF8 paths, decimal u64 identity bits, supported options and separate operation/cleanup results.
Service reservations cover preparing/live/closing work, bounded poll/update lanes, receipt retention, quota release on Joined and provider fencing on unconfirmed cleanup.
ProcessSearchBackend retains accepted open/poll/update/cleanup tasks after observer cancellation; paired release ownership survives startup races and preserves first operation failure.
Input logical-size and identity checks run before encoding/admission; obsolete/mismatched frames are fenced; unconfirmed release retains allocation.
Explicit immutable process cwd is validated and does not mutate host cwd, package identity or durable-state location. Catalog selection rejects incompatible search contract upgrades.
limits: Service tests use a controlled backend and process tests use a protocol peer fixture, not the native matcher behind an independently installed worker.
Catalog fixtures and source contracts do not establish actual external search-package build/install/removal/replacement.
The post-test missing-identity hardening branch has compilation/lint evidence only.
No new CLI/App Server executable or GUI interaction was tested here. High-level App Server client shutdown work in the WIP is outside these compiled scopes.
